label: Japan holds a digital coin as a national reserve standard
description: Seen 5 November 2025 as a tilled field with a corn-like stalk growing out of it and a coin at the top, interpreted as a future reserve: Japan will hold this as its standard the way America is said to be backed by gold. He adds that a country in South America will do the same and that it will be pronounced soon, and says he sees two.
aliases: at the top of it is a coin

label: Three men at the Central Bank of Iraq standing in the way
description: Given amid repeated calls of oil and natural resources and an instruction to watch Iraq: three men at the Central Bank are still standing in the way. The count of three is the checkable element; no names are given.
aliases: three men at the Central Bank

label: A device routed from Ukraine to New York harbour
description: Seen 5 November 2025: a line running from Ukraine to New York harbour and from there to a bomb, with a specific building in view that he says he will try to identify afterwards by searching for it.
aliases: From Ukraine to New York harbor

label: The New York power grid goes down and parts of the city go dark
description: Seen 4 November 2025: the power grid going down again, complete darkness in parts of New York, and buildings lit from outside by generators and spotlights, followed by people leaving the city in droves.
